Author: CompSciLauren
Description:
[center]Blue                                Water-Blue                              Pink                                  Purple                                 Green
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/h4YZZzHD/1.png[/img]﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/8zQKN8px/2.png[/img]﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ncQRyVJv/3.png[/img]﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/cLRDJD6C/4.png[/img]﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/xd96NKbR/5.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/xddpsTjg/Features.png[/img][list]
[*]Character automatically wears pajamas when at home. You can choose which color of pajamas to wear in the Config!
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W18f6JVh/Installation.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/2SrKZ7Ps/Compatibility.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.4 or later on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer.
[*]Not compatible with Get Glam mod. Using both mods may lead to unexpected behavior. When this has been fixed, this warning will be removed. Thank you for your patience!
[*]Not compatible with Home Sewing Kit mod. Using both mods may lead to unexpected behavior. When this has been fixed, this warning will be removed. Thank you for your patience!

[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/xTKZ84FG/Config.png[/img]﻿
{
  "PajamaColor": "Blue"
}

"PajamaColor" options are the following:
[list]
[*]Blue
[*]Water-Blue
[*]Pink
[*]Purple
[*]Green
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MZfN2T7F/Future.png[/img]
